trial_title: Myeloid Cells in Aortic Valve Stenosis
brief_summary: Investigators plan to characterize systemic inflammation and circulating immune cells in participants with moderate and severe calcific aortic valve disease and matched healthy controls.

eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient over 18 years of age?

eligibility_table.criterion: Mild, moderate or severe degenerative aortic valve stenosis as defined by transthoracic echocardiography according to the 2017 ESC/EACTS guidelines for the management of valvular heart disease.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has severe aortic stenosis, which meets the inclusion criterion for degenerative aortic valve stenosis.
There is no indication of active auto-inflammatory or auto-immune diseases in the patient's profile.
The patient is on Lasix and a beta-blocker, which are not classified as anti-inflammatory drugs.

eligibility_table.criterion: Vaccination less than one month before inclusion
eligibility_table.justification: There is no mention of vaccination within the last month in the patient's history.
The patient has not undergone bone marrow transplantation.

eligibility_table.criterion: Active malignancy, except for local basal cell carcinoma or local squamous cell skin carcinoma, that can be treated curatively by excision.
eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication of active malignancy in the patient's profile.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of endocarditis of the aortic valve
eligibility_table.justification: There is no history of endocarditis of the aortic valve noted in the patient's medical history.

eligibility_table.criterion: History of radiation therapy aimed at the chest
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not received radiation therapy aimed at the chest.

eligibility_table.criterion: Acute ischemic cardiac event less than three months before inclusion
eligibility_table.justification: There is no record of an acute ischemic cardiac event within the last three months.

eligibility_table.criterion: Systemic inflammation less than one month before inclusion with fever and/or for which antibiotics have been prescribed, with the exception for the use of nitrofurantoin for a urinary tract infection without fever
eligibility_table.justification: There is no evidence of systemic inflammation or recent fever in the patient's profile.
